name: Real-ESRGAN — AI upscale for stills and frames
description: Learned detail reconstruction at 2x and 4x. Photographic, lightweight and illustration models, plus the compact video-trained variant.

files.name: RealESRGAN_x4plus.pth
files.note: General photographic, 4x. RRDBNet 23 blocks — the slowest and the most detailed.

files.name: RealESRGAN_x2plus.pth
files.note: The same network trained at 2x. Better at 2x than running the 4x model and resampling back down.

files.name: realesr-general-x4v3.pth
files.note: SRVGGNetCompact. Roughly an order of magnitude faster than the RRDBNet models — the practical choice for video.

files.name: RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.pth
files.note: Illustration and cel-shaded art, 4x. Flattens skin and texture on photographs.

files.name: realesr-animevideov3.pth
files.note: Compact illustration model trained on video frames. Still per-frame, but steadier on motion than the 6B model.
